claim_being_audited: That certifying the model is compliant and evidentially supported despite a known model-card weakness, because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and limited rollout controls plus monitoring make launch acceptable if the limitation is explicitly disclosed.
specific_concerns: The governing policy says rollout controls and monitoring mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable.
The actor packet itself states the health-plan benefits support segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The actor packet itself states the available risk acceptance draft is incomplete and does not address that exposed use case.
Because the affected segment remains exposed and reviewed risk acceptance is missing, the policy predicate for relying on rollout controls is unresolved.
Public guidance about transparency and ongoing measurement supports disclosure and monitoring, but does not by itself satisfy the policy condition for exposure of the affected use case.
unsupported_claims: That certification is compliant on the basis of rollout controls and monitoring when the affected health-plan benefits support use case remains exposed without completed reviewed risk acceptance.
That the strongest defensible certification case has been fully established from admissible evidence alone rather than remaining conditional on missing approval or exclusion evidence.
evidence_requests: A completed and reviewed risk acceptance record that explicitly addresses the health-plan benefits support exposure and explains why continued exposure is acceptable.
Evidence that the affected health-plan benefits support use case is excluded from the initial rollout cohort if no approved risk acceptance exists.
The actual model-card disclosure text showing the limitation is expressly disclosed for the exposed segment.
Any approval record or governance review confirming certification under this exact exposure condition.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold.
Policy threshold here requires either exclusion of the affected use case or reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable.
Rollout controls, rollback capability, dashboards, and small initial percentage do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
Public governance guidance can support disclosure and monitoring expectations, but cannot substitute for the missing policy predicate.
